name: addToWatchlist
title: Add To Watchlist
description:
Adds a movie or TV show to the signed-in user's watch list and returns the
created entry.

Duplicate contract: each user can hold a given title at most once, enforced
by the database. Calling this for a title already on the list changes
nothing and fails with a BAD_REQUEST error whose message says the title is
already in the watch list. Agents should treat that specific error as
confirmation that the goal state already holds, not as a failure to report
or retry.

When `status` is omitted, the entry is created as WANT_TO_WATCH.

subject.description: The title to add: exactly one of movieId or tvShowId.

status.description: Optional initial status, WANT_TO_WATCH or WATCHED. Omit for the default WANT_TO_WATCH.

name: confirmAction
title: confirmAction
description:
Execute a previously staged action by confirmation token. Single-use.
Tokens expire 60 seconds after staging.

name: ping
title: ping
description: Smoke-test tool. Returns a greeting that echoes the supplied name. Used during Class 6 to verify the MCP server wiring before real tools are added in Class 7.

name.description: Name to greet. Any non-empty string.

name: recommendMoviesForMood
title: Recommend Movies For Mood
description:
Recommends up to ten movies that fit a given mood for the current user,
if authenticated; the operation also works for anonymous callers.
Suitable for low-stakes recommendation flows ("I want something fun tonight")
where the user benefits from a curated suggestion instead of an exhaustive
search. Results are ranked by rating, highest first, with a stable tiebreak
on id, so repeated calls return the same order; an agent that retries sees
the same ordering and does not need to reason about result drift. Returns
an empty list (never null) when the catalog does not contain any matches
for the mood; an empty list is a valid answer, not a failure.

input.description: Recommendation input: mood (one of COMFORT, ADVENTURE, ROMANCE, HORROR, THOUGHTFUL, COMEDY) and an excludeWatched flag, which the input schema requires on every call. Send false unless the user wants movies they have already marked WATCHED on their watchlist filtered out.

name: stageRemoveFromWatchlist
title: Stage Remove From Watchlist
description:
Stage removal of an item from the signed-in user's watch list.
Returns a confirmation token. The actual removal only happens when
the user calls confirmAction with the returned token within
60 seconds. Tokens are single-use.

name: summarizeMovieReviews
title: Summarize Movie Reviews
description:
Returns a structured summary of user reviews for a given movie, computed
server-side from the underlying review corpus (integer scores from 1 to 10
plus free-text comments). The result includes a short summary of
what reviewers said and recurring themes pulled from the review text.

Always returns a non-null `MovieReviewSummary` for a movie that exists;
unknown ids produce a NOT_FOUND error instead of a null result, so this
field never returns null. When there are fewer than three reviews, the
system has insufficient material to produce a meaningful `summary`, so
that field is null and the agent should read `reviewCount` to see how
many there were; `averageScore` is null only when `reviewCount` is zero.

When there are zero reviews, the operation still returns a
`MovieReviewSummary` whose `reviewCount` is zero, whose `summary` and
`averageScore` are null, and whose `themes` list is empty, so the agent
can distinguish "no reviews exist" from "fewer than three reviews exist"
by inspecting the result shape instead of guessing from null alone.

movieId.description: Movie ID, as it appears in the schema.
